name: text-widgets
description: Trumpet technical challenge: independent, auto-saving text widgets

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @text-widgets/server" "npm run dev -w @text-widgets/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @text-widgets/web && npm run build -w @text-widgets/server
